definitions.gloss: to contain within; to encompass; to harbor; to carry inherently
definitions.explanation: To have something contained or embedded within as an inherent part, often something abstract like a problem, contradiction, or potential. More intellectual and abstract than physical containment.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{内包|ないほう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This plan contains many problems within it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現代|げんだい}{社会|しゃかい}→現代社会：11501_gendaishakai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{内包|ないほう}する⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧。
examples.english: Contradictions that modern society harbors within itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{内包|ないほう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えている→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧。
examples.english: This technology harbors great potential, but at the same time carries risks.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb from ⟦{内包|ないほう}→内包：20106_naihou⟧, composed of ⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ (inside) + {包|ほう} (to wrap, to contain). Used almost exclusively for abstract concepts — problems, contradictions, meanings, potential — rather than physical objects.

USAGE:
A formal, intellectual word common in academic writing, journalism, and critical analysis. Rarely used in casual conversation. In logic, ⟦{内包|ないほう}→内包：20106_naihou⟧ also has the technical meaning of "intension" (the set of attributes defining a concept), contrasting with {外延|がいえん} (extension).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{内包|ないほう}する — to harbor problems
- ⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{内包|ないほう}する — to contain contradictions
- ⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{内包|ないほう}する — to hold potential within
- ⟦{危険性|きけんせい}→危険性：17827_kikensei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{内包|ないほう}する — to carry inherent danger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧ — to contain, to include (everyday; broader usage)
- ⟦{孕|はら}む→孕む：12295_haramu⟧ — to harbor, to be pregnant with (also abstract; literary)
- ⟦{抱|かか}える→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧ — to hold, to carry (more concrete; problems, debt, etc.)
